### Headline summary
- Alibaba has officially launched Qwen4-Max, a 2.4-trillion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model featuring a 1-million token context window. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-16/alibaba-unveils-new-flagship-ai-model-in-riposte-to-us-rivals), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p25#a261115p25))
- The US Commerce Department issued an interim rule requiring licenses for remote access to advanced AI chips from specific countries to close security loopholes. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p2#a261116p2), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p27#a261116p27))
- Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating CEO Jensen Huang despite significant public support and pressure from US President Donald Trump. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p24#a261115p24), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo))

### Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max flagship AI model
Alibaba has officially launched Qwen4-Max, a 2.4-trillion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with a 1-million token context window. The company claims the model offers significant cost reductions and improved security safeguards compared to its predecessors and US rivals. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-16/alibaba-unveils-new-flagship-ai-model-in-riposte-to-us-rivals), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p25#a261115p25), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p26#a261115p26), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/alibaba-cloud-releases-qwen4-max-with-25-lower-singapore-api-prices/))

### US restricts remote access to advanced AI chips
The US Commerce Department issued an interim rule requiring licenses for remote access to advanced AI chips and servers from specific countries, including Singapore and Malaysia. The move aims to close a loophole that allowed Chinese companies to access US compute resources overseas. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p2#a261116p2), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p27#a261116p27), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-11-16/us-moves-to-restrict-remote-access-to-advanced-ai-chips-video), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/16/us-tightens-ai-chip-export-controls-to-deter-chinese-companies-from-accessing-compute-remotely/))

### Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reinstatement controversy
Nvidia's board is not considering reinstating CEO Jensen Huang, despite an open letter signed by 165,000 people and support from US President Donald Trump. The situation is described as being driven by internal factional conflicts and reports that Huang had planned to pull back the company's aggressive financing strategies. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261115/p24#a261115p24), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/16/elon-musk-tech-execs-open-letter-jensen-huang-return-nvidia-ceo), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p25#a261116p25), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p31#a261116p31))

### Anthropic IPO preparations and governance
Anthropic is preparing for an IPO with a valuation potentially reaching one trillion dollars, with CFO Krishna Rao leading the financial preparations. The company's founders will retain 50.1% voting control, and the offering is drawing attention from major investors like Altimeter Capital and Wall Street, while raising questions about governance and market impact. ([Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://theconversation.com/anthropics-trillion-dollar-ipo-is-open-to-australians-theres-a-catch-for-small-investors-296603), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/13/technology/anthropic-ipo-spending-plans.html), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/experts-question-anthropics-ipo-safeguards-for-public-benefit/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-ipo-big.html))

### Apple launches Health AI Usage Study
Apple has launched a US-based study involving up to 200,000 users to investigate how people interact with conversational AI for health. The study utilizes an app powered by OpenEvidence that can access HealthKit data. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1033355/apples-new-study-looks-to-improve-the-effectiveness-of-ai-health-tools), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/15/apple-launches-new-app-to-study-how-people-use-ai-for-health/), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/11/apple-launches-research-study-to-explore-the-use-of-ai-for-health/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/apple-opens-u-s-study-of-trust-in-conversational-health-ai/))

### Sam Altman comments on AI industry stability
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated that the AI industry will be fine despite the uncertainty surrounding Nvidia's leadership changes. He expressed empathy for Jensen Huang while noting the sector's strong revenues and demand. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-16/altman-says-ai-industry-will-be-fine-after-huang-s-ouster), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p38#a261116p38), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/16/sam-altman-on-nvidia-without-jensen-huang-the-industry-will-be-fine/))

### OpenAI embeds Apollo Research evaluators
OpenAI announced that six evaluators from Apollo Research will be embedded within the company to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversion. This is part of a broader agreement with independent assessors for model evaluations. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p33#a261116p33), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/16/openai-will-embed-apollo-researchers-to-investigate-ai-subversion/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/apollo-research-to-embed-six-evaluators-in-openai-subversion-pilot/))

### OpenAI announces tools to combat CSAM
OpenAI has introduced a new image classifier and warning screens in ChatGPT to prevent users from accessing child sexual abuse material. Accounts attempting to access such content will face a 24-hour ban as a warning. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/16/openai-releases-a-new-image-classifier-and-chatgpt-warnings-to-combat-csam/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261116/p39#a261116p39))

Alibaba says Qwen4-Max, which isn't open weight, beats Fable 5.1 and Kimi K3.1 Pro in coding benchmarks, and plans to release weights for smaller Qwen4 models (Luz Ding/Bloomberg)
